Marshall & Dominguez LLP
Pearland, TX
Phone 281-555-1704
Settlement Demand
December 21, 2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1227 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Our office represents Michael Wells in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on September 27,
2023. Our client was lawfully making a left turn when your insured failed to yield the right of way and struck the
driver's side of our client's vehicle. The police report and the photographs taken at the scene reflect the force of the
impact and the damage to both vehicles.
As a direct result of the collision, Michael Wells sustained neck and back strain. Our client experienced immediate
pain, stiffness, and reduced range of motion, and was advised by treating providers to attend physical therapy and to
limit lifting and driving while recovering. Our client has missed time from work and continues to experience discomfort
that interferes with daliy activities.
Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured had a duty to exercise reasonable care and to yield when oncoming traffic
was approaching, and the failure to do so caused the collision and our client's injuries. Our client has incurred medical
expenses, lost wages, and general damages for pain and suffering.
We therefore demand payment of $114,000.00 to resolve all claims against your insured arising from this incident.
This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response
within that period, we are authorized to file suit without further notice.
Expert review: Janet Williams, neurologist
Sincerely,
Nina Stewart
Marshall & Dominguez LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
